ops.title: Eliminate proven repeated Capt transcript metadata and tail work
ops.description: Owned post-Capt12.108.10/SDK14.45.28 audit. Retained bounded metrics at fundamental-efficiency/capt10-postrewrite-audit prove repeated lease-free tail reads and repeated current registered graph roster construction. Exact 5524-resource digest matches 5523 explicit registered Codex IDs plus one root; preserve every authorized evidence source. Distinguish logical source counters from physical IO. Identify exact callers and reuse existing indexed/raw/stamped machinery only where semantics are preserved. No live transcript replay, broad corpus scan, model calls, lifecycle/recycle, or local tests. Root standing authority covers proven source fix through normal CI/release and named installed affected proof; do not close from source or publication alone.

ops.text: Source-bound repeat-work mechanism and exact caller are proven; narrow fix preserves authority, provisional append/rewrite, output/window and explicit registration semantics, with independent review and meaningful old-fail/new-pass CI.
Normal merged source is included in an official verified release and matching installed App/CLI/SDK, preserving protected sessions and old environments with qualified unknowns.

One bounded installed affected-case proof shows the repeated cost removed without live-corpus replay; retained physical IO attribution and original Slack recovery remain explicitly unproven unless separately measured.
